articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly analyze video, audio, and code in a single inference pass rather than relying on separate encoders. Benchmarks show a 34% improvement on complex software engineering tasks (SWE-Bench Ultra) and near-human performance on graduate-level scientific reasoning. The model is available via API with significantly reduced latency compared to the original GPT-5 release.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves New State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind published results showing Gemini Ultra 2 solving 89% of International Mathematical Olympiad problems at a gold-medal level, up from 72% with the previous generation. The system combines enhanced chain-of-thought with a novel formal verification loop that checks proof validity during generation. Researchers say this represents a significant step toward AI systems that can contribute original mathematical proofs.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot has begun pilot operations at two major logistics partner facilities, performing picking, packing, and palletizing tasks with reported 97% grasp success rates. The new generation features improved actuators providing 40% more torque and an overhauled vision-language-action model for real-time task adaptation. Tesla aims to scale to 20 deployment sites by Q1 2027.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Dexterous Manipulation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform featuring new hands with 22 degrees of freedom, enabling fine-grained manipulation tasks such as connector insertion and tool use in automotive assembly lines. The system uses a transformer-based motor control policy trained in simulation and fine-tuned with real-world teleoperation data. Hyundai plans to integrate 50 units into its Ulsan manufacturing complex by early 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework for Enterprise Autonomous Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new enterprise framework that enables Claude-based autonomous agents to operate in multi-step workflows while adhering to company-defined safety constitutions and human escalation policies. The framework includes audit logging, interpretability dashboards, and real-time constraint verification at each agent action step. Early adopters in financial services and healthcare report a 60% reduction in AI-related compliance incidents.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 process node using next-generation gate-all-around transistors, roughly three months ahead of its original roadmap. The node delivers an 18% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, with initial production allocated to major AI accelerator customers. This positions TSMC to supply chips for the next wave of AI training clusters expected to come online in 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Logical Qubit Error Rates Below Fault-Tolerance Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum reported achieving logical qubit error rates of 10⁻⁸ on their latest trapped-ion quantum system using improved topological error correction codes, crossing below the widely accepted threshold for fault-tolerant quantum computing. The demonstration used 56 physical qubits to encode 4 logical qubits and sustained error suppression over 10,000 operational cycles. Researchers say practical quantum advantage for specific chemistry and optimization problems could now be achievable within 2-3 years.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Compliance Audits Targeting Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the EU AI Act's general-purpose AI model provisions, requesting detailed documentation from six major foundation model providers on training data, evaluation results, and systemic risk mitigation measures. Companies face potential fines of up to 3% of global revenue for non-compliance. The audits are being closely watched as a precedent for how regulators will practically enforce AI governance at scale.
